surface: Re-exports `@tanstack/store@0.11.1` unchanged and implements the stable React binding surface (`useSelector`, `useAtom`, `useCreateAtom`, `useCreateStore`, `createStoreContext`, and deprecated `useStore`) on Octane hooks.
divergences: The upstream experimental `_useStore` hook is intentionally omitted; use `useSelector` with `store.actions` or `store.setState` instead.
ssr: Supported: selectors, writable atoms, and store context read their current snapshots during server rendering; the adapter has no browser-only initialization.
notes: Adapted upstream suite runs the pinned repository index.test.tsx one-for-one against the Octane binding, with OCTANE DIVERGENCE cases for the omitted experimental _useStore export.

Differential coverage runs one shared fixture through this adapter and real @tanstack/react-store@0.11.1, covering selectors, comparator bailouts, atom writes, component-created atoms and stores, actions, and context.

Behavioral conformance coverage additionally checks source replacement, independent call sites, nested provider resolution, subscription cleanup, deprecated useStore, and server output; type tests cover all overload families.
The 0.11.1 dependency and runtime oracle reuse byte-identical React adapter source from 0.11.0. The immutable 0.11.0 source/test lock and all pristine/adapted obligations remain in place.
